create_standard_embedding: create a StandardEmbedding with a given vocab size and embedding dimension
create_vocab_sharded_embedding: create a VocabShardedEmbedding sharded across the vocabulary dimension for tensor parallelism
create_sharded_embedding: create a ShardedEmbedding sharded across the embedding dimension for tensor parallelism
convert_to_vocab_sharded: convert a StandardEmbedding to a VocabShardedEmbedding using VocabShardedEmbedding.from_embedding
init_scaled_embedding: initialize a StandardEmbedding with scaled normal distribution using init_scaled_embedding
